mod.name: Artifacts
mod.blurb: Wearable artifacts found in dungeons and from Mimics. In this pack, RAR-Compat turns them into levelled relics.

meta.description: Adds various new powerful uncraftable items to make exploration a bit more interesting

items.name: Novelty Drinking Hat
tooltips: 'Hey! I'm #1, and I let gravity do my drinking!'

items.name: Umbrella
tooltips: Can be used as a shield

abilities.name: Soft Fall
abilities.description: When held in hand, reduces the player's vertical speed, negating fall damage. Pressing LMB propels the player backward and triggers a cooldown of **2-1.5 (up to 0.6-0.4)** seconds. The push can be used up to **1-3 (up to 11-13)** times in succession before the player touches the ground.

abilities.name: Air Shield
abilities.description: When used, functions as a shield, pushing targets up to **1-3 (up to 2-6)** blocks away.

artifacts:umbrella.description: Softens the fall, providing safe landing from any height. When skillfully used, it can serve as a reliable shield, keeping enemies at bay.

abilities.name: Gallop
abilities.description: Increases the movement speed, jump height, and safe fall height of mounts by **20-30 (up to 50-75)**%.

abilities.name: Lasso
abilities.description: When used, this ability allows you to ride and control any mob for up to **2-5 (up to 5-12.5)** seconds. After the time expires or dismounting, it goes on a 1-minute cooldown.

artifacts:cowboy_hat.description: Enhances the agility of the relic bearer’s mounts.

abilities.name: Clear Vision
abilities.description: Removes the fog effect in liquids.

abilities.name: Breath Control
abilities.description: Applies a water breathing effect for **5-10 (up to 15-30)** seconds upon full submersion.

artifacts:snorkel.description: Allows for longer underwater exploration without the risk of drowning.

abilities.name: Flatulence
abilities.description: Has a **20-40 (up to 35-70)**% chance to knock back entities within a **3-5 (up to 4.5-7.5)** block radius, applying a 10-second nausea effect when taking damage or crouching frequently.

artifacts:whoopee_cushion.description: Mysteriously increases the relic bearer's flatulence, leading to entirely unpredictable outcomes.

abilities.name: Big Loot
abilities.description: Has a **10-20 (up to 35-70)**% chance to apply an additional level of Looting to defeated mobs. If successful, the ability repeats, adding another Looting level. This continues until the chance fails, summing all levels.

artifacts:superstitious_hat.description: Increases loot drops from defeated mobs.

abilities.name: Generous Catch
abilities.description: Has a **10-20 (up to 35-70)**% chance to increase the amount of catch received. If successful, the ability repeats, adding more catch. This continues until the chance fails, summing all catches.

abilities.name: Gamma Vision
abilities.description: Enhances the brightness of poorly lit areas and reduces the effectiveness of blindness and darkness by **10-15 (up to 60-90)**%.

artifacts:night_vision_goggles.description: Allows the relic bearer to see more clearly in the dark.

abilities.name: Innocent Appearance
abilities.description: Prevents Iron Golems from attacking the player.

abilities.name: Trade Secret
abilities.description: Increases the discount when trading with villagers by **10-20 (up to 40-80)**%.

artifacts:villager_hat.description: Reduces trading prices with villagers, making deals more profitable.

abilities.name: Concentrated Strike
abilities.description: Increases knockback in melee attacks by **20-40 (up to 50-100)**%.

abilities.name: Long Reach
abilities.description: Increases maximum interaction range with the world by **20-40 (up to 50-100)**%.

artifacts:pocket_piston.description: Grants the relic bearer's hands the strength of mechanisms.

abilities.name: Life Steal
abilities.description: Heals the player for **10-20 (up to 20-40)**% of the damage dealt.

artifacts:vampiric_glove.description: Grants the relic bearer's attacks a vampiric effect, healing them by a portion of the damage dealt.

abilities.name: Thirst for Knowledge
abilities.description: Increases experience gained from killing mobs by **20-40 (up to 50-100)**%.

artifacts:golden_hook.description: Allows the relic bearer to perform more precise attacks, retaining more experience from killed mobs.

abilities.name: Heat Concentration
abilities.description: Smelts any mined block if possible, consuming one charge from a buffer with a capacity of **20-25 (up to 70-75)** units. The buffer regenerates 1 charge every **7-6 (up to 1.2-1)** seconds.

artifacts:pickaxe_heater.description: Concentrates surrounding heat precisely onto the relic bearer's tools.

abilities.name: Beast's Fury
abilities.description: Increases the player's attack speed by **5-15 (up to 11-33)**% for each consecutive attack performed within 3 seconds of the last. Otherwise, loses 1 charge per second. Attacking with an unfilled attack speed bar resets the accumulated charges.

artifacts:feral_claws.description: Awakens a bloodthirsty instinct in the relic bearer, making them fight faster with each consecutive attack.

abilities.name: Pickaxe Hands
abilities.description: Reduces the required tool level for all blocks by 1.

abilities.name: Fast Mining
abilities.description: Increases block mining speed by **15-35 (up to 75-175)**%.

artifacts:digging_claws.description: Strengthens the relic bearer's hands, allowing them to chop through any blocks more effectively.

abilities.name: Power Strike
abilities.description: Increases the player's damage dealt by **80-100 (up to 400-500)**% but enters a 5-second cooldown after each attack.

artifacts:power_glove.description: Allows the relic bearer to perform empowered attacks.

abilities.name: Fire Wave
abilities.description: When attacking, releases several sparks that home in on nearby targets, igniting them for **1.5-2.5 (up to 6-10)** seconds and dealing **5-15 (up to 16-50)**% of the performed attack's damage. The number of sparks is determined through repeated checks of a **20-30 (up to 50-75)**% chance. Each successful check releases one additional spark, but the process stops as soon as the chance fails even once.

artifacts:fire_gauntlet.description: Grants the relic bearer’s weapon the powers of the fire element.

abilities.name: Wither Resistance
abilities.description: Grants complete resistance to wither damage.

abilities.name: Withering Touch
abilities.description: Has a **20-40 (up to 40-80)**% chance to apply the Wither effect to the attacked target for **2-4 (up to 6-12)** seconds.

artifacts:withered_bracelet.description: Fills the relic bearer's weapon with withering energy, affecting all it touches.

abilities.name: Miner's Hunger
abilities.description: Increases block mining speed by **1-1.5 (up to 3-4.5)**% per unit of the player's saturation.

abilities.name: Raw Appetite
abilities.description: When mining blocks, there is a **5-15 (up to 10-30)**% chance to restore 1 hunger point and 0.5 saturation to the player.

artifacts:onion_ring.description: Enhances the relic bearer's block mining efficiency when sufficiently satiated.

abilities.name: Treasure Hunter
abilities.description: Has a **10-20 (up to 35-70)**% chance to apply an additional level of Luck to mined blocks. If successful, the ability repeats, adding another Luck level. This continues until the chance fails, summing all levels.

artifacts:lucky_scarf.description: Increases Luck level when mining blocks.

abilities.name: Fiery Defense
abilities.description: Has a **20-30 (up to 40-60)**% chance to ignite the target attacking the player for **2-3 (up to 8-12)** seconds.

artifacts:flame_pendant.description: Burns anyone who dares to attack the relic bearer.

abilities.name: Anchor
abilities.description: Doubles the player's sinking speed.

abilities.name: Diver
abilities.description: While the player stands on the underwater floor, it blocks air consumption and slowly restores its supply by **0.2-0.4 (up to 0.6-1.2)** seconds every second.

artifacts:charm_of_sinking.description: Grants the relic bearer's legs the ability to absorb air from the ground.

abilities.name: Invincibility
abilities.description: Increases the duration of invulnerability after taking damage by **0.3-0.5 (up to 0.9-1.5)** seconds.

artifacts:cross_necklace.description: Envelops the relic bearer in a protective aura, granting temporary invulnerability after each hit taken.

abilities.name: Compression
abilities.description: Reduces the player's size by **20-30 (up to 40-60)**%.

artifacts:charm_of_shrinking.description: Allows the relic bearer to shrink their body to access previously unreachable areas.

abilities.name: Panic
abilities.description: Increases the player's movement speed by **1-2 (up to 2-4)**% for each mob within a **6-8 (up to 12-16)** blocks radius targeting the player for attack.

artifacts:panic_necklace.description: Quickens the relic bearer's heartbeat, warning of impending danger.

abilities.name: Electric Resistance
abilities.description: Grants complete resistance to lightning damage.

abilities.name: Lightning Defense
abilities.description: Has a **10-20 (up to 20-40)**% chance to strike the target attacking the player with lightning, dealing **1-3 (up to 3-9)** damage.

artifacts:shock_pendant.description: Strikes with lightning anyone who dares to attack the relic bearer.

abilities.name: Poisonous Defense
abilities.description: Has a **10-20 (up to 25-50)**% chance to reflect **5-15 (up to 10-30)**% damage and apply poison to the target attacking the player for **2-4 (up to 8-16)** seconds.

artifacts:thorn_pendant.description: Poisons anyone who dares to attack the relic bearer.

abilities.name: Silent Step
abilities.description: Grants the player complete invisibility. The effect is lost for **7-5 (up to 3.5-2.5)** seconds upon any interaction with the world. If during the absence of invisibility any mob targets the player, the effect will not restore until that mob won't lose sight of the player.

artifacts:scarf_of_invisibility.description: When moving carefully, makes the player invisible to surroundings.

abilities.name: Jumper
abilities.description: Allows high jumps by continuously holding the jump key for up to **0.15-0.25 (up to 0.45-0.75)** seconds.

artifacts:bunny_hoppers.description: Strengthens the relic bearer's legs, allowing them to push off the ground more powerfully.

abilities.name: Herbivory
abilities.description: Every **7-6 (up to 2-1.7)** seconds transforms the grass block beneath the player into dirt, restoring 1 hunger and saturation point.

artifacts:rooted_boots.description: Grants the relic bearer the mysterious power of a sheep.

abilities.name: Cat's Gaze
abilities.description: Scares away all Creepers and Phantoms near the player.

abilities.name: Soft Paws
abilities.description: Increases safe falling height by **2-4 (up to 10-20)** blocks.

abilities.name: Nine Lives
abilities.description: Has a **5-10 (up to 17.5-35)**% chance to save the player from fatal damage, leaving them with 1 health point.

artifacts:kitty_slippers.description: Grants the relic bearer feline traits, including soft paws and countless lives.

abilities.name: Light Step
abilities.description: Allows walking on powder snow without sinking.

abilities.name: Snow Walker
abilities.description: Increases movement speed on snow by **20-40 (up to 40-80)**%.

artifacts:snowshoes.description: Improves the relic bearer's mobility in harsh snowy conditions.

abilities.name: Fish Tail
abilities.description: Increases the player's swimming speed by **20-40 (up to 70-140)**%.

artifacts:flippers.description: Strengthens the relic bearer's legs, allowing them to swim faster.

abilities.name: Wide Stride
abilities.description: Increases the player's running speed by **50-80 (up to 150-240)**%.

artifacts:running_shoes.description: Strengthens the relic bearer's legs, allowing them to move faster.

abilities.name: Clinging Claws
abilities.description: Allows slow wall sliding, negating fall damage.

abilities.name: Grip
abilities.description: Increases resistance to knockback and slippery blocks by **20-30 (up to 50-75)**%.

artifacts:steadfast_spikes.description: Firmly anchors the relic bearer's feet to any surface.

abilities.name: Temporal Loop
abilities.description: Each attack against the relic bearer has a **2-4 (up to 4-7)**% chance per percent of missing health to teleport the attacker to a random location within a **5-7 (up to 10-14)** block radius.

artifacts:chorus_totem.description: Allows the relic bearer to rewind time when making rash decisions.

abilities.name: Magnetism
abilities.description: A toggleable ability with 3 modes: Attraction, Repulsion, and Neutrality. In the red Attraction mode, items within a radius of **3-5 (up to 13-15)** blocks are drawn toward the player. In the blue Repulsion mode, items are pushed away. The purple Neutrality mode disables the relic's effect.

artifacts:universal_attractor.description: Manipulates a weak magnetic field around the relic bearer, controlling the gravity of nearby items.

abilities.name: Air Swimmer
abilities.description: When performing a double jump, allows the player to float in the air for up to **3-5 (up to 9-15)** seconds. Movement speed in the air is proportional to the player's swimming speed with an additional bonus of **20-30 (up to 60-90)**%.

artifacts:helium_flamingo.description: Temporarily allows the relic bearer to glide through air as they would water.

abilities.name: Will to Live
abilities.description: Increases the player's maximum health by **2-6 (up to 6-18)** points.

artifacts:crystal_heart.description: Grants the relic bearer extra strength by increasing their maximum health.

abilities.name: Heat Resistance
abilities.description: Completely absorbs damage from fire sources for up to **2-3 (up to 8-12)** seconds. If the player has not taken fire damage for 3 seconds, the absorption time regenerates each second.

artifacts:obsidian_skull.description: Redirects heat aimed at harming the relic bearer onto itself.

abilities.name: Translocation
abilities.description: Teleports the player to a position along their line of sight within **5-15 (up to 33-100)** blocks, then goes on a cooldown for **5-4 (up to 1.2-1)** seconds.

artifacts:warp_drive.description: Allows the relic bearer to teleport their body over short distances.

abilities.name: Poison Resistance
abilities.description: Reduces the duration of negative effects received by **20-40 (up to 40-80)**%.

abilities.name: Alchemical Touch
abilities.description: Each successful attack steals **1-1.5 (up to 5-7.5)** seconds from all positive effects present on the target.

artifacts:antidote_vessel.description: Enhances the relic bearer's resistance to effects.
